about: BROCCOLI art pack slots. Put PNG files (transparent background) directly in packages/content/art/; the build inlines them and each one replaces the procedural drawing of its slot. Missing files fall back to the procedural art.
units: w/h/pivot are in world units (1x). Supply files at the listed scale (3x or 4x): the game reads the scale from the file's height.

camera.view: three-quarter top-down, ground plane squashed to 0.78 (camera about 51 degrees above the ground)
camera.light: key light from the upper-left (about 10 o'clock, 45 degrees up); shadows fall to the lower-right

owners: Either one file per owner: <id>@0.png (green), <id>@1.png (red), <id>@2.png (blue), <id>@3.png (purple), <id>@n.png (neutral stone/grey) - or one neutral <id>.png plus a grayscale <id>_team.png mask (white = team colour, black = keep) that the game tints.

slots.includes: building + its own ground (yard, steps) + contact shadow; no flag
slots.flag: drawn live by the game on the roof peak; keep the peak where the template has it

slots.what: Sprout Village, level 2 (adds a side wing)
Sprout Village, level 4 (taller crown, golden finial)
Thorn Tower body, level 1, stone base on a rock outcrop; no launcher head
Thorn Tower body, level 3 (wider platform, more thorns)
Launcher head seen from above, pointing RIGHT (+x); rotated by the game toward the target
Same head, string pulled back just before a shot (optional)
Sun Forge with a lit furnace mouth (the fire, embers and smoke are animated by the game)
Broccoli soldier strip, 15 frames of 34x42 left to right: run side x4 (facing RIGHT), run toward camera x4, run away x4, attack wind-up, attack thrust, hit
slots.rules: same feet line in every frame; shield with team emblem on the camera side; leave the ground shadow out (the game adds it)

slots.what: Knocked-out soldier lying on the ground (cartoon, no gore)
